_meta.note: Bias labels are copied from Media Bias/Fact Check. Where a podcast has no MBFC page of its own, the rating of its parent outlet is used and marked rating_applies_to=outlet. Megyn Kelly's journalist page is used for The Megyn Kelly Show and marked rating_applies_to=host. Shows with no MBFC page for the show, host or a clear parent outlet are marked unpublished; no lean is invented for them. MBFC Pro-Science is kept as the published label and grouped with Centre in the on-site filter. AllSides and Ad Fontes were not used (HTTP 403 from the build machine, same as sources.json). Parent-outlet ratings for BBC, the Guardian, NPR, Sky News, Al Jazeera, CBC, Fox News, the Daily Wire, National Review and Reuters match the published ratings recorded in sources.json (checked 2026-11-12). Newly fetched MBFC pages (Vox, Crooked Media, The Dispatch, Quanta Magazine, Nature, Megyn Kelly journalist page) were checked on 2026-11-13.

excluded.the-daily: The Daily (New York Times) has a working public RSS with full-length playable MP3s (https://feeds.simplecast.com/Sl5CSM3S), but nytimes.com is excluded as a metered paywall, so the show was not added.
excluded.coffee-house-shots: Coffee House Shots has a working public Acast feed, but The Spectator is excluded as a metered paywall.
excluded.ukraine-the-latest: Ukraine: The Latest has a working public Acast feed, but The Telegraph is excluded as a metered/paywalled outlet.
excluded.axios-today: The Axios '1 big thing' / Axios Today feed (https://feeds.megaphone.fm/axiostoday) last published in September 2024.
excluded.science-friday: The official Science Friday podcast feed last had an episode in September 2023; the older Feedburner URL last updated in 2019.
excluded.60-second-science: The Scientific American 60-Second Science iTunes feed returned HTTP 404.
excluded.the-today-podcast: The historical BBC Radio 4 Today Podcast feed (p0gg4k6r.rss) now serves 'Radical with Gabriel Gatehouse', not The Today Podcast.
excluded.post-reports: Parent outlet (Washington Post) is a metered paywall.
